card.name: The word If opening an overdosage section
card.fires_on: The word "If" right after the OVERDOSAGE section heading (often numbered 10), as in "If overdose occurs". Weaker on the comma after an opening clause in overdose text.

modes.description: The first word "If" directly following the numbered OVERDOSAGE heading.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE<< If>> overdose occurs, the patient must be monitored

modes.description: A comma ending an introductory clause at the start of an overdose section.
